en.bdb: Praises of the Wondrous Guru  the Lord

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਅਨੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: a(n)bar dharat vichhoRian kudharat kar karataar kahaiaa|

en.bdb: God has stabilized earth and sky separately and for His this power He is known as the creator.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਣੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਥੰਮਾਂ ਆਗਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee a(n)dhar paaneeaai vin tha(n)maa(n) aagaas rahaiaa|

en.bdb: He has settled earth in water and without props the sky He has placed in a stable position.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇੰਨ੍ਹਣ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਗਿ ਧਰਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: ei(n)nhan a(n)dhar ag dhar ahinis sooraj cha(n)dh upaiaa|

en.bdb: Putting fire in the fuel He has created sun and moon shining day and night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹਮਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਚਲਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rut baarahamaeh kar khaanee baanee chalat rachaiaa|

en.bdb: Making six seasons and twelve months He has undertaken the sport of creating four mines and four speeches.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: maanas janam dhula(n)bh hai safal janam gur pooraa paiaa|

en.bdb: Human life is rare and whosoever has found the perfect Gum, his life has become blessed.
Meeting the holy congregation man is absorbed in equipoise.
